input: 앞으로 가다가 초음파 거리가 10cm 이하면 멈춰줘.
output:
from pinkylib import Motor, Ultrasonic
import time

motor = Motor()
sensor = Ultrasonic()
try:
    motor.enable_motor()
    while True:
        distance = sensor.get_dist()
        if distance <= 10:
            motor.stop()
            print(f"장애물 감지: {distance:.2f} cm")
            break
        motor.move(20, 20)
        time.sleep(0.1)
finally:
    motor.stop()
    motor.disable_motor()
    motor.close()
    sensor.close()

from pinkylib import Camera

camera = Camera()
try:
    camera.set_calibration("camera_calibration.npz")
    camera.start()
    frame = camera.get_frame()
    output_frame, pose = camera.detect_aruco(frame, marker_size=0.036)
    print("마커 위치:", pose)
    camera.display_jupyter(output_frame)
finally:
    camera.close()

from pinkylib import Camera

camera = Camera()
try:
    camera.set_calibration("camera_calibration.npz")
    camera.start()
    frame = camera.get_frame()
    output_frame, pose = camera.detect_aruco_target(frame, target_id=1, marker_size=0.036)
    print("ID 1 위치:", pose)
    camera.display_jupyter(output_frame)
finally:
    camera.close()
